24: ftxui::Element compare_pane(const AlgoResults& metrics) {
25:     using namespace ftxui;
26: 
27:     const auto fastest = std::ranges::min_element(metrics, {}, &AlgoResult::use_time_ms);
28:     const auto fewest_comparisons =
29:         std::ranges::min_element(metrics, {}, &AlgoResult::compare_count);
30:     const auto max_comparisons =
31:         std::ranges::max(metrics | std::views::transform(&AlgoResult::compare_count));
32:     const auto max_time =
33:         std::ranges::max(metrics | std::views::transform(&AlgoResult::use_time_ms));
34: 
35:     auto summary =
36:         vbox(
37:             {text(" Compare Summary ") | heading_text(catppuccin_mocha.mauve) | center,
38:                 separator() | color(catppuccin_mocha.mauve),
39:                 text(std::format(
40:                     "Fastest algorithm: {} ({} ms)", fastest->name, fastest->use_time_ms)),
41:                 text(std::format("Fewest comparisons: {} ({})",
42:                     fewest_comparisons->name,
43:                     fewest_comparisons->compare_count))}) |
44:         themed_border(catppuccin_mocha.mauve);
45: 
46:     Elements table_rows{
47:         text("Algorithm        Matches    Comparisons      Time(ms)") |
48:             heading_text(catppuccin_mocha.green),
49:         separator() | color(catppuccin_mocha.green)
50:     };
51:     for (const AlgoResult& metric : metrics) {
52:         table_rows.push_back(text(std::format("{:<14} {:>8} {:>16} {:>13}",
53:             metric.name,
54:             metric.match_count,
55:             metric.compare_count,
56:             metric.use_time_ms)));
57:     }
58:     auto metrics_table =
59:         vbox(
60:             {text(" Metrics Table ") | heading_text(catppuccin_mocha.green) | center,

62:                 vbox(std::move(table_rows))}) |
63:         themed_border(catppuccin_mocha.green);
64: 
65:     auto percent = [](long long value, long long max_value) {
66:         return max_value == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>((value * 100) / max_value);
67:     };
68:     auto bar = [](long long value, long long max_value) {
69:         constexpr int bar_width = 36;
70:         const int filled = max_value == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>((value * bar_width) / max_value);
71:         std::string result;

75:         }
76:         return result;

342:                                         event.mouse().button == Mouse::WheelDown)) {
343:                 return scroll_compare(event.mouse().button == Mouse::WheelUp ? -3 : 3);
344:             }
345:             return false;
346:         }
347: 
348:         const bool can_scroll_detail =
349:             tab_con.idx == 0 && !app_state.search_res.empty() && menu_con.idx >= 0 &&
350:             static_cast<size_t>(menu_con.idx) < app_state.search_res.size();
351:         if (!can_scroll_detail) {
352:             return false;
353:         }
354: 
355:         auto scroll_detail = [&](int delta) {
356:             detail_scroll = std::max(0, detail_scroll + delta);
357:             return true;
358:         };
359:         auto is_in_detail_area = [&](int x, int y) {
360:             if (is_in_box(menu_box, x, y)) {
361:                 return false;
362:             }
363:             if (is_in_box(detail_box, x, y)) {
364:                 return true;
365:             }
366:             return is_in_box(body_box, x, y) && x > menu_box.x_max;
367:         };
368: 
369:         if (event == Event::PageUp) {
370:             return scroll_detail(-8);
371:         }
372:         if (event == Event::PageDown) {
373:             return scroll_detail(8);
374:         }
375:         if (event == Event::ArrowUpCtrl) {
376:             return scroll_detail(-1);
377:         }
378:         if (event == Event::ArrowDownCtrl) {
379:             return scroll_detail(1);
380:         }
381:         if (event.is_mouse() &&
382:             (event.mouse().button == Mouse::WheelUp || event.mouse().button == Mouse::WheelDown)) {
383:             if (!is_in_detail_area(event.mouse().x, event.mouse().y)) {
384:                 return false;
385:             }
386:             return scroll_detail(event.mouse().button == Mouse::WheelUp ? -3 : 3);
387:         }
388:         return false;
389:     });
